defects.title: /audit/aggregate endpoint exists in KitchenOperationsEndpoints but no UI screen in PosTerminal client
defects.invariant: Backend endpoints exposed via KitchenOperationsEndpoints must have corresponding frontend screens in the PosTerminal client for operator access
defects.mechanism: KitchenOperationsEndpoints.cs lines 483-499 define GET /audit/aggregate/{aggregateType}/{aggregateId} with ReportsView permission gate. However, a search across all PosTerminal client source (src/Clients/PosTerminal/src) finds zero references to 'audit/aggregate' or 'audit/correlation' in any route, component, or API call. The eksik-avcisi.md finding explicitly states "/audit/aggregate ekranı yok" and classifies it as static report classification without runtime verification. The endpoint is live but unreachable by operators.
defects.source_evidence: evidence/V1-RMD-739/ui/eksik-avcisi.md:10; src/Host/Experience/KitchenOperations/KitchenOperationsEndpoints.cs:483-499; search of src/Clients/PosTerminal/src for 'audit/aggregate' returns 0 matches
defects.acceptance: Implement a Kitchen Operations Audit Aggregate screen in PosTerminal client (e.g., under features/kitchen-operations or routes) that calls the /audit/aggregate endpoint and displays results. Add navigation/link from KitchenOperationsWorkspace or management menu. Verify end-to-end with a test that loads the screen and fetches data.

limitations: The defect is confirmed by source code inspection: the backend endpoint exists and is wired in KitchenOperationsEndpoints.cs, but no frontend consumer exists in the PosTerminal client codebase. The eksik-avcisi.md finding is a static classification from code reading, not a runtime verification - but the code search confirms zero frontend references.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
